THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Chicken Alfredo Crunch Nests

Crisp hash-brown shells, thick cottage-cheese Alfredo with Costco chipotle chicken, and a Parmesan-mozzarella lid that actually cracks.

YIELD6 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min prep + 35 min cook
COOK METHODSheet pan
EST. / SERVING~340 cal | ~28g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: SQUEEZE THE HASH BROWNS VERY DRY. Fully thawed, wrung out in a clean towel until the mound holds together and the towel is wet. Wet potato = no crisp.

Ingredients

HASH-BROWN SHELLS

  • 15 oz plain frozen shredded hash browns (thaw + squeeze very dry)
  • 2 large egg whites
  • 1/4 cup / 22g finely grated Parmesan
  • 2 tsp cornstarch
  • 2 tsp avocado oil + 1-2 tsp for brushing the pan
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper

CHEESE CRISP LIDS

  • 1/3 cup finely grated Parmesan
  • 1 1/2 oz shredded part-skim low-moisture mozzarella

ADULT FINISH (per plate)

  • 2 finished nests with crisp lids
  • One-fourth of the 20 oz lemon-broccoli batch
  • Fresh lemon zest or juice at the finish

CHICKEN ALFREDO FILLING

  • 12 oz Costco chipotle chicken (cooked, finely chopped)
  • 1 cup 2% cottage cheese
  • 2 tbsp 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/4 cup / 22g finely grated Parmesan
  • 1 tsp cornstarch
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/4 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning
  • 1/4 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/8 tsp black pepper

LEMON BROCCOLI (per dinner)

  • 20 oz broccoli florets
  • 1 tbsp avocado or olive oil
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1 wedge lemon (zest or juice to finish)

Option 1

  • 1 finished nest with crisp lid
  • Broccoli portion (appetite-based)
  • Small dish of prepared Alfredo sauce (creator used Rao's) — for dipping

Allergens: dairy, eggs. Gluten varies by chicken and hashbrown brand

AT PLATING. Nests are identical; the split lives only in nest count per plate and whether Alfredo dip goes on the kid side.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.HEAT + PREP. Oven 415 F, racks upper + lower thirds. Brush all 12 muffin cups with 1-2 tsp avocado oil.
  2. 2.BAKE LIDS. Mix Parm + mozz on parchment, divide into 12 loose 2 1/4-inch rounds. Bake 5-7 min until bubbling + deeply golden. Cool completely so they turn brittle.
  3. 3.SHELL MIX. Squeeze thawed hash browns very dry in a clean towel. Combine with egg whites + Parm + cornstarch + oil + garlic + salt + pepper.
  4. 4.PRESS SHELLS. About 35g per cup. Thin across bottom + up shallow sides, visible rim.
  5. 5.ROAST SHELLS + BROCCOLI. 20 oz broccoli tossed with oil + garlic + salt on a sheet pan next to the muffin pan. Rotate + swap racks at 12 min. Broccoli 18-22 min, shells 18-23 min.
  6. 6.ALFREDO. Blend cottage cheese + milk + Parm + cornstarch + spices until mostly smooth. Warm over medium-low, stirring, until steaming + thick. Fold in chopped chipotle chicken. Do not boil.
  7. 7.FILL + BAKE. Oven to 390 F. Spoon ~50g (level 1/4 cup) warm filling into each shell, rim exposed. Bake 6-8 min to 165 F.
  8. 8.REST + REVEAL. Rest 4 min. Loosen with a silicone/wooden utensil. Add cooled lids only at the table.

Adult — 2 Nests + Lemon Broccoli

  1. 9.PLATE THE ADULT. 2 nests + one-fourth of the broccoli. Finish broccoli with lemon.
  2. 10.ADD LIDS LAST. Set cooled cheese lids on each nest at the table so they stay brittle.

Kid — 1 Nest + Broccoli + Alfredo Dip (Creator's Build) · Option 1

  1. 9.KID TRAY. 1 nest + broccoli in a separate compartment + small dish of Alfredo for dipping.
  2. 10.ALFREDO DIP OPTIONAL. Rao's Alfredo warmed slightly. Not included in adult macros.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — 2 Nests + Lemon Broccoli: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — 1 Nest + Broccoli + Alfredo Dip (Creator's Build): Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • EGG WHITES ONLY. Not whole eggs. Fat softens the shell.
  • ABOUT 35 G SHELL MIX PER CUP. Thin across the bottom, up the shallow sides, leaving a visible rim.

If something fails

Shells stuck to the pan: Muffin cups weren't brushed with oil, or shells were pulled before the rims turned deeply golden. Brush every cup with 1-2 tsp avocado oil, and bake until the rims + bottom edges are clearly golden. Loosen with a silicone or wooden utensil after the 4-min rest.

Cheese lids went chewy: Lids sat on hot filling too long. Cool lids completely on the parchment and add only at the table. Store night-two lids in an airtight container at room temp; do not refrigerate.

Alfredo curdled: Warmed over too-high heat or brought to a boil. Rebuild: medium-low heat, stir constantly, take off at the first steaming/thickening. Cornstarch thickens as it cools too — do not chase thicker on the stove.

Shells crumbled when lifting: Not squeezed dry enough, or oil brushing skipped, or pulled before deeply golden. All three failure modes compound — hit each on the next batch.

Filling ran off the sides: Filled past the rim or shells too thin at the bottom. Aim for a level 1/4 cup and leave a visible rim of potato exposed on top.

Adult plate reads under 28g protein: Chipotle chicken portion drifted low. Weigh 12 oz cooked chicken across 12 nests = 1 oz per nest. Or bump to 14 oz total and recalculate labels.

Night-two shells got soft: Re-crisp at 400 F for ~5 min before filling. Do not re-microwave the shells; the oven is the only reheat that keeps the crunch.

Storage and reheating

Store: Fill only 6 nests on night one. Refrigerate the remaining baked shells, filling, and cheese lids separately for up to 3 days.

Reheat: Re-crisp shells at 400 F for ~5 min. Warm the filling, then fill and bake at 390 F for 6-8 min to 165 F. Roast the second 20 oz broccoli fresh. Add lids only at the table.

Lasts: 3 days refrigerated for baked shells and filling. Cheese lids keep 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature — do not refrigerate.

Estimated nutrition

~340 cal | ~28g protein.

Brands I use

Costco / Kirkland
Chipotle Seasoned Grilled Chicken
Pre-cooked smoky chipotle chicken. 12 oz filled 12 nests at 1 oz each. Any pre-cooked seasoned chicken subs in; recalculate macros for the brand.
Rao's
Homemade Alfredo Sauce
The creator's kid-dipping sauce. Familiar flavor bridge from the shell/filling to the kid palate. Optional — not included in adult macros.
Fairlife
2% Ultra-Filtered Milk
The 2 tbsp in the Alfredo. Ultra-filtered milk is higher-protein than regular 2%; any 2% milk works.
